title: 10 Best Polygonum Bistorta Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Polygonum bistorta are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and poultices, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the dried roots are commonly used to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, which involve simmering the root for a longer time, are valued for their deeper extraction of active compounds. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s ground parts, are used as soothing demulcents for irritated mucous membranes. Poultices made from fresh roots can be applied topically to treat skin conditions and wounds.
